notes.title: 📺 Live Now: Forged in Germany – Iconic Dev Stream
notes.content:
Join the Developer for a Preview of Iconic in its Current State
Join us as we dive into Iconic, our new take on the horde survival roguelite genre featured in the Games Forged in Germany event! 🛡️⚔️
